changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.12.4 has been released! This hotfix IS required to continue to play online!

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️ 
```- Added Custom Track Worldwides and Regular Track Worldwides to the VR multiplier weekend rotation.
- Added a code to disable special item box properties for specific tracks. For now, this only effects Haunted Woods.
- Modified the luma voice mute to only apply when custom characters have no luma.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜 
```- Fixed an issue with custom items where specific items will not be able to be pulled as fallback items.
- Fixed an issue where track voting would display all non submitted votes as a "random" vote.
- Fixed an issue with Online TT where changing combo after track selection would softlock the game.
- Other minor bug fixes and improvements.```

This should be the final hotfix unless something else decided to break 🗿 
Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
